name: cpx-vscode
description: Competitive programming for VS Code: fetch samples, run them locally, and submit from Codeforces, CSES, and AtCoder.

commands.title: CPX: Run Samples for Active File
CPX: Copy Code and Open Submit Page

cpx.defaultLanguage.description: Language for new solution files. With pypy, .py files run under PyPy.

cpx.workspaceFolder.description: Folder for solutions. Blank means the first VS Code workspace folder, or ~/cpx if none is open.

cpx.templates.markdownDescription: Your own starting file per language, as a path. Example: `{ "cpp": "C:/cp/template.cpp" }`.

cpx.commands.markdownDescription: Override how a language builds and runs. Placeholders: `{source}`, `{exe}`, `{out}`, `{dir}`. Example: `{ "cpp": { "compile": "g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -o {exe} {source}" }, "python": { "run": "python3 {source}" } }`. An empty compile skips the build step.

cpx.subfolderPerPlatform.description: Put solutions in a folder per judge (codeforces/, cses/, atcoder/) instead of directly in the solutions folder.
